notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, another small update... here is the change log:

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where balls could get stuck ontop the grave hole
[*]Fixed a bug where the game could randomly freeze or stop functioning correctly
[*]Added LEDs to the dungeon table bones
[*]Added feedback on the quest display and the flippers if you've ran out of health
[*]Moved the menu to the left
[*]Improved controller support
[*]Several more smaller fixes and polishing
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

sorry for the inconvenience regarding the last update. I've fixed the camera now and also added an option to switch to a top-down camera in the settings menu for those who prefer that. :)

Cheers,
 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hello,

we already got our first update on hand with a list of improvements:

[list]
[*]The camera is now closer to the table and the backplate UI smaller so you can see more of the action
[*]Instead of having to memorize menu hotkeys to pause the game you can now fold out the menu by pressing ALT, making it much more convinient.
[*]You can now unlock additional inventory bags on higher levels (15, 30 and 50)
[*]Added loading screen tipps
[*]Some set-dressing for the environment room
[*]Misc bug fixes
[/list]

I hope you like these changes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42448534/78042393828a9bec7c5baed41673ae1fddec44d6.png[/img]

Cheers,
 Tim
